title: 2024 Sanlam Cape Town Marathon Final Race Instructions (official PDF)
claims: The 42.2 km route has 15 hydration stations approximately 3 km apart, serving water, Coke, Coke No Sugar and Powerade in cups rather than plastic sachets.
A Woolworths food station is placed before 24 km, after Hydration Station 8 and before Hydration Station 9.
The medical partners are Mediclinic and ER24, with three medical and physio points, three first-aid stations and a fully staffed hospital at the finish.
The 2024 medical emergency number is 021 023 2720 and the general emergency number is 021 300 1286.
The 2024 race had 10 cut-off points at 7.0, 11.0, 14.0, 20.0, 25.3, 30.5, 32.6, 36.0, 38.7 and 41.7 km, with cut-off times from 08:20 to 13:39 and an average cut-off pace of 09:32 per kilometre.

The 2024 cut-off locations are Searle St / Victoria Rd, Main Rd / Rhodes Avenue, Claremont Blvd / Hemlock Blvd, Milner / Park Rd, Liesbeek Parkway / Link Rd, Darling Str / Adderley Str, Long Str / Wale Str, Main Road at RS 14, Queens Rd Circle at MyCiTi Station, and Helen Suzman / Bill Peters Rd.
Mini sweep buses patrol the route and mega sweep buses collect runners at all cut-off points.
There is no parking at the race village or on the route, and illegally parked vehicles will be towed.
Park & Walk uses free parking at Battery Park in the V&A Waterfront on a first-come, first-served basis, with paid parking at Silos sold at the Expo; all cars had to be parked by 05:00.
Toilets are located next to the start chutes, at all route hydration stations and on the finishers field.
The event describes itself in the 2024 document as Africa's only Abbott World Marathon Majors candidate.
